basic_details.job_title: CUK Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior research fellow: 1. B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering or relevant degree with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or not less than 60%.2. M.E/M.Tech in Structural Engineering with a CGPA of 6.5 or not less than 60%.Desirable: GATE-qualified candidates.

salary_details.details: The honorarium will be consolidated. No other allowances are admissible.

selection_process: The selection process involves the shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates. The date of the interview will be notified separately.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format from the university website at www.cukashmir.ac.in.
Fill in all the required details in the application form accurately.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant testimonials and certificates as listed in the application format.
Submit the filled application along with documents via the Google form link: https://forms.gle/gfMBveiEjrQBvAT67.

Send the hard copy of the application along with all relevant documents by post or in person to Dr. Asif Hussain Shah (PI), Department of Civil Engineering, Central University of Kashmir, Tulmulla campus, Ganderbal-191131.
Ensure the application reaches the designated address on or before 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the CUK Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the Central University of Kashmir for 1 Junior Research Fellow post under an AICTE sponsored project in the Department of Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under CUK JRF recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CUK Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for CUK JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering or relevant degree with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or not less than 60%, and an M.E/M.Tech in Structural Engineering with a CGPA of 6.5 or not less than 60%.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit specified in the CUK JRF notification?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not specified in the notification.
